```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task SendCheckpointMetadataAsync_LogsInformationOnSuccess()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
        var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
        var mockCkptManager = new Mock<ICkptManager>(); // Assuming interface or mockable
        var mockGcs = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>(new System.Net.IPEndPoint(System.Net.IPAddress.Loopback, 0), null, null, null, null, null, null);

        mockGcs.Setup(x => x.ExecuteSendCkptMetadata(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<int>(), It.IsAny<byte[]>()))
               .ReturnsAsync("OK");

        var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
            mockStoreWrapper.Object,
            mockClusterProvider.Object,
            logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Setup mocks as needed for constructor dependencies
        mockClusterProvider.Setup(x => x.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>()))
                          .Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
        mockStoreWrapper.Setup(x => x.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { ReplicaSyncTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30) });

        // Act
        // Note: This tests the specific logging call on line 463 by verifying the LogInformation call
        // after successful metadata send. Full integration would require more mocks.
        mockLogger.Setup(x => x.LogInformation("<Begin sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}", It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CheckpointFileType>()));
        mockLogger.Setup(x => x.LogInformation("<Complete sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}", It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CheckpointFileType>()));

        // Simulate the send checkpoint metadata logic (this would be internal call)
        var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        await session.SendCheckpointMetadataAsync(mockGcs.Object, Guid.NewGuid(), CheckpointFileType.STORE_SNAPSHOT, mockCkptManager.Object, cts.Token);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("<Begin sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}", 
            It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CheckpointFileType>()), Times.Once);
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("<Complete sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}", 
            It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<CheckpointFileType>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LoggerExtensions_LogInformation_CalledWithCorrectFormat()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
        using var loggerFactory = LoggerFactory.Create(builder => builder.AddProvider(new MockLoggerProvider(mockLogger)));
        var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<ReplicaSyncSession>();

        var fileToken = Guid.NewGuid();
        var fileType = CheckpointFileType.STORE_SNAPSHOT;

        // Act
        logger.LogInformation("<Begin sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}", fileToken, fileType);
        logger.LogInformation("<Complete sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}", fileToken, fileType);

        // Assert - Verify the extension method was called with correct template
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(
            It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
            It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
            It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains($"<Begin sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}") || 
                                        v.ToString()!.Contains($"<Complete sending checkpoint metadata {fileToken} {fileType}")),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.AtLeast(2));
    }
}

// Helper mock provider for ILogger
public class MockLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;

    public MockLoggerProvider(Mock<ILogger> mockLogger)
    {
        _mockLogger = mockLogger;
    }

    public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _mockLogger.Object;

    public void Dispose() { }
}
```
Note: This test targets the specific LogInformation call on line 463 by verifying both the begin and complete logging messages are emitted when checkpoint metadata send succeeds.
